title.zh: 英伟达完成量子纠错技术验证，所需物理量子比特减少90%
title.en: 英伟达完成量子纠错技术验证，所需物理量子比特减少90%

current_state.zh: Nvidia used 8,192 GPUs on the JUPITER supercomputer to simulate a 104-qubit fault-tolerant quantum system and validate magic-state cultivation, claiming a roughly 90% reduction in the physical qubits needed.
current_state.en: Nvidia used 8,192 GPUs on the JUPITER supercomputer to simulate a 104-qubit fault-tolerant quantum system and validate magic-state cultivation, claiming a roughly 90% reduction in the physical qubits needed.
